name: Helical Motion Simulation
description: Simulates the helical motion of charged particles in a uniform magnetic field with optional electric field perturbations.

parameters.name: magnetic_field
parameters.description: Strength of the uniform magnetic field in Tesla

parameters.name: electric_field
parameters.description: Strength of optional electric field perturbation in V/m

parameters.name: particle_charge
parameters.description: Charge of the particle in Coulombs

parameters.name: particle_mass
parameters.description: Mass of the particle in kg

parameters.name: timesteps
parameters.description: Number of simulation timesteps

outputs.name: trajectory
outputs.description: 3D trajectory of the particle over time

name: Cyclotron Resonance Model
description: Models cyclotron resonance heating in tokamak plasmas using a kinetic approach.

parameters.name: resonance_frequency
parameters.description: Target resonance frequency in Hz

parameters.name: plasma_density
parameters.description: Plasma density in particles per cubic meter

parameters.name: heating_power
parameters.description: Input heating power in Watts

parameters.name: radial_points
parameters.description: Number of radial grid points

name: Particle-in-Cell Simulation
description: A 2D particle-in-cell simulation for studying plasma wave interactions and instabilities.

parameters.name: grid_x
parameters.description: Number of grid cells in x dimension

parameters.name: grid_y
parameters.description: Number of grid cells in y dimension

parameters.name: particles
parameters.description: Total number of simulation particles

parameters.name: timesteps
parameters.description: Number of simulation timesteps

name: Magnetic Field Mapping
description: Calculates and visualizes the magnetic field distribution in complex coil geometries.

parameters.name: coil_count
parameters.description: Number of coils in the geometry

parameters.name: current_amps
parameters.description: Current flowing through each coil in Amperes

parameters.name: resolution_mm
parameters.description: Spatial resolution of the field map in millimeters

parameters.name: domain_size_m
parameters.description: Size of the computational domain in meters

name: Heat Diffusion Model
description: Solves the heat diffusion equation for thermal analysis of fusion reactor components.

parameters.name: thermal_conductivity
parameters.description: Material thermal conductivity in W/(m·K)

parameters.name: initial_temperature
parameters.description: Initial temperature of the component in Kelvin

parameters.name: boundary_temperature
parameters.description: Fixed temperature at boundaries in Kelvin

parameters.name: simulation_time
parameters.description: Total simulation time in seconds

parameters.name: use_adaptive_mesh
parameters.description: Enable adaptive mesh refinement
